append: - I want to undo a mistake.

intro/commit.wrong: git commit --allow-empty -m Nothing && rm glass && git commit --allow-empty -m StillNothing
intro/commit.verify_wrong: test ! -e glass && test "$(git rev-list --count HEAD)" = 2 && test -z "$(git ls-tree HEAD)"

intro/remote.verify_wrong: git rev-parse --verify teacher/main && ! git merge-base --is-ancestor teacher/main main

files/files-delete.wrong: rm tiny_web big_web thick_web bed && touch bedpost

files/files-add.wrong: echo blue > chair; echo blue > lamp
solution: echo yellow > chair; echo yellow > lamp

branches/checkout-commit.wrong: git checkout --detach $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: Little sister does something$/ {print $1; exit}')
solution: git checkout --detach $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: Little sister does something$/ {print $1; exit}') && git restore --source=HEAD^ -- little_sister piggy_bank && git commit -am Restore
git checkout --detach $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: The child buys something$/ {print $1; exit}') && echo "Looks well fed" > cage/lion && git commit -am Lunch

git branch -f birthday $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: Go to the birthday$/ {print $1; exit}') && git branch concert $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: Go to the concert$/ {print $1; exit}')

branches/grow.wrong: git checkout --detach birthday && git commit --allow-empty -m Unchanged && git checkout concert && git commit --allow-empty -m Unchanged
branches/grow.verify_wrong: git diff --quiet concert^ concert -- you && git rev-parse --verify concert^^
solution: git checkout --detach birthday && echo cake >> you && git commit -am cake
git checkout concert && echo applause >> you && git commit -am applause
git branch -D friend ice-cream; git branch -D music || true
git branch -m coffee temp && git branch -m baguette coffee && git branch -m temp baguette
git checkout donut && echo "You ate a donut." >> you && git commit -am Eat

merge/merge.wrong: git checkout --detach $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: You eat the donut$/ {print $1; exit}')
solution: git checkout --detach $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: You eat the donut$/ {print $1; exit}') && git merge --no-edit $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: You eat the baguette$/ {print $1; exit}') && git merge --no-edit $(git reflog --all --format="%H %gs" | awk '/commit: You drink the coffee$/ {print $1; exit}')

merge/conflict.wrong: git merge --ff-only pancakes && (git merge --no-edit muesli || true) && git add sam && git commit -m Unresolved
merge/conflict.verify_wrong: git rev-parse --verify main^2 && git show main:sam | grep -q '^<<<<<<<'
solution: git merge --no-edit pancakes; git merge --no-edit muesli || true; echo "Had pancakes and muesli. Is at work." > sam; git add sam; git commit -m Compromise
echo "The alarm is ringing" > smoke_detector && git commit -am Alarm
git add red_candle && git reset HEAD -- green_candle blue_candle
echo fell >> hammer; echo smashed >> bottle; echo dissolved >> sugar_cube
git add bottle && git commit -m Bottle
git add sugar_cube && git commit -m Sugar
echo Third >> essay && git commit -am Third && git push
echo Fifth >> essay && git commit -am Fifth && git push
git pull --no-rebase --no-edit || true; echo "The bike shed should be turquoise" > file; git add file && git commit -m Compromise && git push
git rebase baguette coffee && git rebase coffee donut && git branch -f main HEAD
git checkout main && git branch original && git reset --hard main~4 && git cherry-pick original~1 original~2 original~3 original

shit-happens/restore-a-file-from-the-pas.verify_wrong: test "$(git rev-list --count main)" = 1 && test "$(cat essay)" = "good version"
solution: git restore --source=HEAD^ essay && git commit -am Restored

workflows/pr.wrong: git clone ../friend . && git checkout -b solution && echo "2 + 3 = 55" > file && git commit -am Wrong && git tag pr
solution: git checkout -b solution && echo "2 + 3 = 5" > file && git commit -am Solution && git tag pr
git bisect start main main~29 && git bisect run sh -c 'grep -q "still have" you' && bad=$(git rev-parse refs/bisect/bad) && git bisect reset && git checkout main && git reset --hard "$bad^"

stash/stash-pop.verify_wrong: test -z "$(git stash list)" && ! grep -q Flour recipe

stash/stash-branch.verify_wrong: git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/unrelated && git rev-parse --verify refs/stash

stash/stash-merge.wrong: git commit --allow-empty -m "Flour and Salt" && git stash clear
stash/stash-merge.verify_wrong: test "$(git log -1 --format=%s)" = "Flour and Salt" && test -z "$(git stash list)"
solution:
git stash apply || true; printf "Apple Pie:
- 4 Apples
- 500g Flour
- Pinch of Salt
" > recipe; git add recipe && git commit -m Combine && git stash drop

tags/add-tag-later.verify_wrong: git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/v1 && ! git show-ref --verify refs/tags/v1

tags/remote-tag.wrong: git branch v1 HEAD^ && git branch v2 HEAD && git push friend refs/heads/v2
tags/remote-tag.verify_wrong: git -C ../friend rev-parse --verify refs/heads/v2 && ! git -C ../friend show-ref --verify refs/tags/v2
solution: git fetch friend --tags && git tag v2 HEAD && git push friend v2
git switch -c practice && echo practice > exercise && git add exercise && git commit -m Practice
git switch -c practice && echo practice > exercise && git add exercise && git commit -m Practice
